replaces_instruction: Don't patch the symptom and move on: reconstruct what actually happened, test each candidate cause against the evidence (would removing it have prevented this?), and fix the level where recurrence is actually blocked.
ambiguities: The root cause singular is the practice's own recurring bug — failures are stacks (§ below); RCA theater names a proximate trigger and closes the ticket; the counterfactual test is what separates analysis from narrative.
example_directive: Full RCA on the outage: evidence preserved first, timeline second, but-for tests on each candidate third — and the deliverable names both the trigger and the enabling conditions, or it comes back.

term: Root cause vs. contributing factors (the causal stack)
implied_procedure: Model the failure as a stack: the trigger (the match), the enabling conditions (the dry forest), and the absent safeguards (the missing firebreak); remediation addresses each layer it wants to keep; any single-layer story is flagged as incomplete.
replaces_instruction: The deploy didn't cause the outage alone: it was the trigger. The stale failover config and the unmonitored queue were the fuel. Write the stack — trigger, conditions, missing safeguards — and fix at the layers you choose to keep.
ambiguities: Legal causation doctrine (proximate cause) pulls toward the single culpable event; Swiss-cheese framing (§ below) is the same model in defense-layer clothing; "contributing factor" lists without assignment of which layer gets the fix are decoration.
example_directive: Causal stack for the incident: trigger (config push), enablers (cache TTL, silent queue growth), absent safeguards (no I&W on depth) — the remediation PR must touch at least two layers.

implied_procedure: Model defenses as layered slices each with holes (active failures and latent conditions); harm passes only when holes align across all layers; analysis asks which holes aligned, and hardening asks which layer's holes to shrink or shuffle — not which single hole "caused" it.
replaces_instruction: Every safeguard has gaps, and the disaster happened because the gaps lined up that day: map the alignment, then shrink or de-synchronize the holes in the cheapest layers — no single hole is the culprit.
ambiguities: Aviation-medicine origin (Reason); the model explains pass-through, not why each hole existed (that's the RCA's job); static hole-thinking misses that holes drift (§12 normalization of deviance).
example_directive: Swiss-cheese the leak: reviewer gap + scanner exclusion + shared credential aligned across the three layers — the fix shuffles at least one layer, not just patches the reviewer.

implied_procedure: First loop: correct errors against current goals and norms. Second loop: question the goals and norms themselves in light of the error; when single-loop fixes keep recurring, the defect is in the governing variables, and the second loop is mandatory.
replaces_instruction: Beyond fixing the mistake against today's rules — ask whether today's rules produced the mistake: if this same class of fix keeps coming back, the goals or assumptions themselves are the thing to change.
ambiguities: Management-theory coinage (Argyris); double-loop on everything is thrash — the trigger is recurring single-loop fixes; easily invoked as an excuse to relitigate settled strategy after every stumble.
example_directive: Third queue-overflow fix this quarter: double-loop it — the governing assumption (unbounded ingest is fine) is now on the table along with the patch.

implied_procedure: Derive the sanctioned unreliability from the SLO (e.g., 99.9% ⇒ 43 min/month); burn it consciously, tracking the burn rate; when the budget exhausts, feature work halts in favor of reliability work until rebuilt — the halt is the mechanism, the budget is the currency.
replaces_instruction: Reliability has a price and we've agreed to pay it in error-minutes: spend them knowingly, watch the burn rate, and when you've spent them all, new features stop until the account refills.
ambiguities: SRE heritage (Google); the policy's force is entirely in the enforced feature-freeze (without it, it's a dashboard); budget arithmetic is a governance device, not an engineering truth about acceptable harm.
example_directive: The migration burned 30% of the quarter's error budget in a night: feature freezes per policy until we're back under 15% — the freeze is automatic, not a meeting outcome.

implied_procedure: Consume your own output under real conditions: the team uses the product as primary, in production, with real stakes; defects surface through lived pain rather than synthetic reports; complaints route through the same channels as customers'.
replaces_instruction: Use it yourself, for real, as your only option — eat what you cook — because the bugs you'll tolerate as a spectator you'll fix as a victim.
ambiguities: Team-unrepresentativeness (power users forgiving expert-hostile UX) limits the evidence value; mandated dogfooding without escape-valve reporting becomes suffering theater; distinct from beta (external users, informed consent).
example_directive: The CLI ships when the platform team has run on it exclusively for two weeks; every workaround we caught ourselves performing is a filed issue, not a habit.

implied_procedure: Practice at the edge of current ability on specific subskills, with immediate feedback and repetition with variation; comfort-zone repetition doesn't count; the practice loop includes a coach or criterion that catches drift.
replaces_instruction: Repeating what you're already good at isn't practice: isolate the weak subskill, drill it just past comfortable, get told immediately what was wrong, and vary it until it generalizes.
ambiguities: Expertise-research coinage (Ericsson) now diluted to "practice deliberately, you know, with effort"; for agents: fine-tune on the failure distribution, not the easy pass set — the training-set selection is the practice design.
example_directive: Deliberate practice on incident comms: drill only the degraded-channel scenario we historically fumble, with scored feedback each round and one varied complication per iteration.

implied_procedure: Make predictions with explicit confidence; record them; score against outcomes (Brier-style); adjust confidence-mapping from the scored history; repeat until stated confidence matches hit rate across the range.
replaces_instruction: Say how sure you are in numbers, keep the receipts, and grade yourself later — over time your 80%s should be right 80% of the time, and the only way to get there is scored practice, not introspection.
ambiguities: Forecasting-practice heritage (superforecasters, Tetlock); calibration is domain-specific (80% on your own code ≠ 80% on vendor timelines); the estimative-language scale (§1) is where calibrated confidence gets expressed.
example_directive: Every go/no-go recommendation this quarter carries a number and lands in the calibration ledger; monthly, we plot stated-vs-actual and adjust the mapping.

implied_procedure: Convert each learned lesson into a structural carrier — a test, an alert threshold, a checklist line, a lint rule, a doc section — within the same cycle; lessons existing only in narrative form are counted as lost; the conversion rate is itself tracked.
replaces_instruction: A lesson that isn't a test, an alert, a checklist line, or a gate didn't happen: put the learning into a structure that enforces it, this sprint — or admit we're keeping it as a story we enjoy retelling.
ambiguities: Military lessons-learned processes can drown in mandatory paperwork (the ritual outliving the learning); structures rot without owners — the maintenance ticket (preserve, §9) is part of the conversion.
example_directive: Every postmortem action item lands as one of: test / alert / checklist line / lint rule / doc section — owner and carrier named at creation; quarterly report shows conversion rate and rot rate.

term: BATNA (best alternative to a negotiated agreement)
implied_procedure: Before negotiating, identify what you will actually do absent agreement; cost it concretely; improve it if cheap; treat it as the floor — no agreement worse than the BATNA is accepted, by rule rather than mood.
replaces_instruction: Work out your real walk-out option before the call and what it costs us — that alternative, not our hopes, is the floor under every term we discuss.
ambiguities: Distinct from the stated "bottom line" (a number you declare) — BATNA is the real alternative; estimating the counterparty's BATNA is the same discipline mirrored.
example_directive: Compute our BATNA before the vendor call: self-host, three weeks, $40k — anything worse than that on paper gets declined without a meeting.

implied_procedure: Pre-commit the minimum acceptable terms while calm; when breached, terminate rather than continue; the commitment is binding under the pressure of the moment, by prior arrangement.
replaces_instruction: Decide now the worst terms you'll accept — because in the room you'll rationalize anything — and when the offer crosses that line, you leave; the decision was made last week.
ambiguities: Set-during-the-session walk-aways are anchored to whatever is on the table (§12); hidden vs. disclosed reservation points are different strategies; a walk-away you override once becomes advisory forever.
example_directive: Walk-away is 72-hour SLA or we cancel: state it once, act on it mechanically, no renegotiation with ourselves in the hallway.

implied_procedure: Estimate both parties' reservation points; the interval between them is where any deal can exist; no overlap means no deal is reachable at any skill level — change a reservation point or leave, don't negotiate.
replaces_instruction: Map their floor against our ceiling before investing weeks: if those numbers don't overlap, the talks are theater — improve an alternative or walk, no amount of charisma closes a ZOPA that isn't there.
ambiguities: Estimates, not observations — reservation points hide (§ information asymmetry below); the ZOPA shrinks and moves as both sides learn.
example_directive: Their floor is ~$8/user, our ceiling $12: a ZOPA exists — anchor inside it, don't waste rounds outside.

implied_procedure: For each stated demand, elicit the underlying need it serves; negotiate over needs, not formulations; generate options that satisfy the interest through a different position; incompatible positions frequently conceal compatible interests.
replaces_instruction: No deploys on Friday is a position — the interest is incident coverage when staffing is thin: solve for coverage and several designs appear that the Friday-ban never would.
ambiguities: Requires disclosure the other side may resist (their interest is leverage); agent-relevant in requirement disputes: the stated spec is a position, the constraint behind it is the interest.
example_directive: Before countering the "no Friday deploys" rule, extract the interest: if it's on-call coverage, propose the coverage roster and keep the deploys.

implied_procedure: Recognize incremental advances that would be rejected as a whole: each slice is calibrated too small to fight; counter by naming the pattern, re-aggregating the slices into the rejected whole, and pricing the sequence, not the step.
replaces_instruction: Watch for slice-by-slice creep: any single concession is trivial, but the sequence ends somewhere you'd have refused in one ask — evaluate the destination, not today's sliver.
ambiguities: The detection is retrospective (the pattern exists after 2–3 slices); legitimate incrementalism (staged rollouts, escalation ladders) shares the form — the discriminator is whether the whole was ever presented and declined.
example_directive: Third "small extension" to the data-sharing scope this month: call it salami — re-open the aggregate scope for decision, not the delta.

implied_procedure: Recognize last-minute small additions after agreement is reached; treat any reopening as reopening the whole; decline by standing rule or the entire package returns to the table.
replaces_instruction: The tiny "one more thing" after yes is a tested exploit: either it's a flat no, or everything is back on the table — absorbing it with a smile trains its repetition.
ambiguities: Politeness norms make refusal socially expensive (the exploit's engine); distinguish the nibble from genuinely discovered scope (which goes through re-scoping, §8, at full ceremony).
example_directive: Contract is signed; the "just add SSO for two admins" request is a nibble — it enters the change process with its own price, not the pen.

implied_procedure: Expose decision-makers to the downside of their decisions structurally (on-call rotation, deferred compensation, shared budget); discount advice from parties immune to consequences by default; design arrangements so downside travels with the choice.
replaces_instruction: Whoever proposes must also absorb some of the pain if it's wrong — recommendations from the consequence-immune get discounted automatically, not argued with.
ambiguities: Taleb-popularized; the structural exposure is the content, not the rhetoric of accountability; agent-translation: an agent that can't bear downside must route its one-way recommendations through someone who can.
example_directive: The proposing team carries on-call for the change's first month — that clause is what makes the proposal a proposal instead of a wish.

implied_procedure: Map each delegation link: whose goal, who executes, how the executor is actually rewarded; the divergences are where reported information gets gamed; verify outcomes at the goal level, not reports at the activity level.
replaces_instruction: At every "X works for Y" layer, ask what X actually optimizes and how X is paid — then check Y's goal directly at the outcome, because the status report was written by X's incentives.
ambiguities: Requires an actual incentive map, not cynicism; applies to tools and agents as much as people (a review-bot optimized for throughput approves everything); moral-hazard framing is the risk-side sibling.
example_directive: Principal-agent check on the outsourced QA: they're paid per closed ticket — audit a sample of closures against the defect-reopened rate before trusting the 98% pass figure.

implied_procedure: Recognize when one party knows more; to learn the informed side's type, either design signals (costly to fake) or screens (choices where each type's honest answer is their cheapest move); never extract truth by asking alone.
replaces_instruction: They know things we don't, and they'll say whatever helps: set up choices where telling the truth is each type's cheapest strategy — the structure reveals what the interview won't.
ambiguities: Economics-formal (Akerlof/Spence) but operationally real in vendor selection, hiring, and agent self-reporting (an agent's confidence claim is cheap talk — demand a costly signal like a reproducible artifact).
example_directive: We can't verify their uptime claims by asking: offer two contract shapes (penalty-backed vs. flat) — the choice screens the ones who believe their own SLA.

implied_procedure: Under scarcity, sort items by the protocol's key (urgency × salvageability × resource cost); apply the ordering rule, not the worst-first reflex; re-sort as states change; categories the protocol assigns to deferred care are honored as decisions.
replaces_instruction: You cannot do everything now: rank by what the protocol says — urgent and savable with available effort first, not the loudest or the sickest alone — and re-rank whenever anything's state changes.
ambiguities: Commonly misread as "worst-first"; different protocols order differently (treatable-first maximizes survivors — mass-casualty logic inverts the ICU's); clinical triage licenses deliberate non-treatment of some categories, which ports to task management only with care.
example_directive: Triage the backlog by sev × recoverable × effort; re-triage every two hours; rescoped items re-enter the sort — they don't keep their old rank by tenure.

implied_procedure: Stabilize first: stop active damage, restore vital functions, then investigate cause; diagnosis proceeds on the stabilized system; some evidence loss to stabilization is accepted by doctrine.
replaces_instruction: Stop the bleeding before asking what caused it: cap the queue, shed load, freeze deploys — the autopsy happens after the patient has a pulse.
ambiguities: Stabilization destroys some forensic state (restarts clear memory) — snapshot first when it's cheap (§7); the doctrine orders stabilization over explanation, not over evidence preservation when both are possible.
example_directive: Site is down: rollback both deploys now, throttle ingest, snapshot the heap — root-cause work starts once error rate is flat, not before.

implied_procedure: Generate at least two competing explanations; list the features that discriminate among them; order tests by information gained; act provisionally on the leader while testing; revise on results; a single-hypothesis conclusion without rivals considered is a defect.
replaces_instruction: List the plausible causes, note which observation would look different under each, test for those differences, treat the front-runner meanwhile, and switch when the results say so — a cause reached without considering its rivals is a guess in a lab coat.
ambiguities: Hickam's counterweight applies (§2): multiple simultaneous causes are the norm in complex systems; in agent use the deliverable is the rivals list — "most likely cause" with no runner-up stated is the failure signature.
example_directive: Differential for the p99 spike: lock contention vs. allocator pressure vs. downstream slow-ramp — one discriminating measurement per hypothesis, ordered by what each would rule out.

implied_procedure: Maintain the predefined marker list for must-escalate conditions; screen every case cheaply and early against it; any flag routes to the escalation path immediately, independent of the assessor's overall severity judgment.
replaces_instruction: Check every case against the known danger signs before anything else: one flag means the escalation path fires, even if the case otherwise looks mild — the list outranks your gestalt.
ambiguities: Depends on the list's maintenance (flags rot: both false-alarm fatigue and missing new flags); the screen is cheap by design so it can run on everything; distinct from sentinel metric (§10) — that watches populations, this screens cases.
example_directive: Every intake passes the red-flag list first: PII in logs, unbounded query, cross-tenant read — any hit pages the security rota before triage continues.

implied_procedure: When evidence is pending and stakes are time-bound: act broadly to cover the likely spectrum, explicitly marked provisional; narrow on arriving evidence; the broad action has a scheduled replacement by the targeted one.
replaces_instruction: Cover all the likely causes now, narrow when the results arrive — the broad move is a bridge with an expiry date, not a conclusion, and "narrow later" is on the calendar.
ambiguities: Broad action carries breadth costs (side effects, blast radius §5) that must be priced; sepsis protocol is the reference; the ops translation is rollback-everything-then-bisect.
example_directive: Empiric first: freeze both suspects' features, restore p99, then bisect to the culprit and un-freeze the innocent one — the freeze has a 48-hour review date.

implied_procedure: Once cause is established, deliberately withdraw the broad measures instituted empirically; verify stability on the narrower regime; each leftover emergency measure is tracked as an open defect.
replaces_instruction: Now that we know it was the config, undo the emergency blocks and reroutes we sprayed at everything — every leftover emergency measure is a small standing outage with our name on it.
ambiguities: De-escalation fear (withdrawal = risk of recurrence) leaves forensic scaffolding in production for years; requires the verification step or it's just forgetting in reverse.
example_directive: Cause confirmed: schedule withdrawal of all four emergency mitigations one per day, each with its own stability check — "temporary" is not a lifecycle.

implied_procedure: Before applying the standard remedy, screen the case against the conditions under which it is harmful; the list is consulted every time, from the document, never from memory; any hit redirects to the alternative protocol.
replaces_instruction: Check the never-do-this list before the usual fix: the standard remedy is actively harmful under some conditions, and those conditions get looked up each time, not recalled.
ambiguities: Pharmacological heritage; the memory-consultation failure is the point (memorized lists decay — §13 normalization); conflated with side effects (unavoidable costs) — contraindications are conditional prohibitions.
example_directive: Before "restart the worker" as first-line: check contraindications — in-flight batch > 10k or replica count < 2 → use the drain-then-restart protocol instead.

implied_procedure: Enumerate all co-present interventions and conditions; check each new addition pairwise against them for harmful interaction; the check re-runs at every addition, not only at baseline.
replaces_instruction: This fix doesn't act alone: check it against the three mitigations already running, pairwise, every time we add anything — drug-interaction logic for operational state.
ambiguities: Pairwise checking misses three-way interactions (known limitation, state it); drift makes the "currently running" list unreliable without a registry (§10 drift detection interlock).
example_directive: Adding the retry-with-backoff? Interaction check: with the circuit breaker's cooldown, retry amplifies 503s to a storm — adjust one or the other, on paper, before merge.

implied_procedure: Identify the interval within which action changes the outcome; inside it, act on partial information (empiric mode); past it, priorities re-rank — investigation and harm-limitation over intervention; the window's edges are stated, not felt.
replaces_instruction: There's a period where doing something beats knowing everything, and a moment after which it doesn't: name both edges now — inside, act dirty; outside, diagnose clean.
ambiguities: Golden hour heritage oversimplifies graded windows; acting-inside-the-window licenses lower evidence standards, which must revert after it closes (empiric-then-targeted interlock).
example_directive: Rollback window is 90 minutes post-deploy (schema still compatible): inside it, rollback on abort criteria without asking; after it, we're in investigate-and-migrate-forward territory.

implied_procedure: Predefine the ordered sequence of increasingly strong interventions; each rung has entry criteria, a dwell time, and an exit check; skipping rungs is a recorded decision; de-escalation descends rung by rung with the same ceremony.
replaces_instruction: Write the ladder from gentle to drastic with each rung's trigger: climb one rung at a time unless you log why you jumped — and coming down gets the same discipline as going up.
ambiguities: Ladders lock in monotonicity assumptions (some situations need rung 3 then rung 1); dwell times are guesses until calibrated (§13); distinguish from escalation control (§16: initiative over the ladder vs. the ladder itself).
example_directive: Cache invalidation ladder: single key → prefix → full flush, each with entry criteria and a 5-minute effect check; the full flush requires a second approver, logged.

implied_procedure: Designate the zero-tolerance error class; any occurrence halts related work for immediate structural remediation and formal report; prevention is engineered (interlocks, §4), never vigilance-based; "be more careful" is not a closure.
replaces_instruction: Some mistakes we refuse to normalize: when one happens, everything stops, the enabling mechanism gets structurally removed, and the report names the mechanism — not a reminder to be careful.
ambiguities: Medical-patient-safety origin (wrong-site surgery class); over-broad designation inflates everything to Sev-1 and dilutes the class; the structural-prevention requirement is what separates it from ordinary severity language.
example_directive: Plaintext credentials in chat are a never event: halt, rotate, purge, and fix the sharing mechanism — the postmortem may not contain "reminded the team."

implied_procedure: State purpose, end state, and hard constraints; delegate method; executors re-plan freely as facts change but never violate intent; when orders conflict with reality, intent arbitrates; verify internalization by scenario, not by nod.
replaces_instruction: Give the why, the finish line, and the non-negotiables — then let the executor choose the how and adapt when reality diverges from plan; when the plan breaks, the intent is the part that survives to be obeyed.
ambiguities: Intent is not license: constraints bind (goal-hacking is compliance theater aimed at intent); requires genuine internalization — the comms-die test ("what would you do if I went silent?") checks it.
example_directive: Task: "Zero data loss, reads restored by 18:00, CFO notified at done — method is yours. If both replicas fail, stop and report rather than improvise beyond the stated bounds."

implied_procedure: Specify what must be achieved and why; never prescribe how; evaluate execution by intent-compliance rather than step-compliance; the order is incomplete unless it carries intent and constraints.
replaces_instruction: State the outcome and the reasons; leave the path to the executor with the best local information — and judge the result against the intent, not against the route you'd have walked.
ambiguities: Prussian doctrine whose price is executor competence and shared doctrine (without both it decays into negligence with a German name); boundaries (ROE, § below) remain binding under method-freedom; misread as "no reporting."
example_directive: Order: "Staging green by Thursday because the demo gates on it." How is yours; daily SITREP still required; the ROE on prod still applies.

implied_procedure: Cycle observe→orient→decide→act at a tempo that keeps your picture fresher than the situation's drift; invest in the orient step (models, priors, assumptions) — it is where the loop wins or amplifies error; detect when your models, not the world, are the lag.
replaces_instruction: Keep cycling: see, update your mental model, decide, act — faster than things change — and notice that the model-updating step is the whole game: fast loops with stale models are error at tempo.
ambiguities: Boyd's payload is orientation quality, but the term circulates as "be fast"; the adversary-degradation half (upsetting their loop) rarely ports to ops; orientation errors are invisible from inside the loop (pair with devil's-advocate, §3).
example_directive: Incident OODA cadence: observations every 5 minutes; orientation stated aloud in one line ("we now believe X because Y"); decide, act, repeat — anyone whose observation contradicts the orientation says so in-channel immediately.

implied_procedure: When guidance is unreachable or stale, act on the known intent within standing constraints; log the decision and its reasoning; report on contact resumption; inaction pending permission is itself a violation when the situation demands motion.
replaces_instruction: No answer from the operator doesn't mean stop: act as the stated intent directs within the written bounds, write down what you did and why, and surface it the moment contact returns — waiting for permission while the house burns is not patience, it's abdication.
ambiguities: Requires pre-published intent and bounds, or it's improvisation wearing a doctrine; deliberately wrong for one-way doors (§8) — the bounds must state which actions are never improvised.
example_directive: If the operator is unreachable past 30 minutes: proceed on stated intent within the envelope, log each decision as made, and hold all one-way actions for contact — then brief on resume.

implied_procedure: Execute the plan under simulation or reduced stakes before the live event, with real timings and real handoffs; gaps found are fixed before the event; the rehearsal itself is scheduled work, not aspiration.
replaces_instruction: Run the whole thing once where mistakes are cheap: same people, same clock, same handoffs — what breaks in rehearsal gets fixed before it counts, and "we'll walk through it on the day" is the opposite of this.
ambiguities: Distinct from test (artifact-level) and drill (single motion) — rehearsal integrates humans and timing; rehearsals in stale environments certify nothing (§6 dry-run caveat).
example_directive: Full migration rehearsal Thursday on the staging copy: real runbook, real on-call rotation, wall-clock timing; every stumble becomes a runbook edit, and Friday's live run cites the rehearsal log.

implied_procedure: Announce a probable task immediately with everything currently known; recipients begin all preparation that doesn't depend on missing details; follow-on orders complete the picture without re-transmitting the known.
replaces_instruction: Tell them it's probably coming, now: what, roughly when, and what's still unknown — prep work starts on the knowns, and nobody idles waiting for the full order.
ambiguities: Probable ≠ ordered — recipients must not treat a WARNO as authority for the action itself, only for preparation; without follow-through discipline it trains alert-fatigue.
example_directive: WARNO: 60% probability of an emergency patch window tonight 22:00–02:00 — stage the artifact, pre-verify the rollback, await the FRAGO or stand-down.

implied_procedure: Issue only the delta against an established base plan: changed steps, times, constraints; everything unreferenced stands exactly as issued; receivers merge the delta onto their copy of the base.
replaces_instruction: The plan stands except for this: report only what changed — don't re-broadcast the whole document for thoroughness, and don't silently rewrite the unchanged parts while you're at it.
ambiguities: Requires an unambiguous base-plan version (deltas against a moving base corrupt silently); "fragmentary" misread as "incomplete/sloppy" — it is precisely scoped, not lazy.
example_directive: FRAGO for tonight: window shifts to 23:00; shard 4 defers to next window; abort criteria unchanged. All else per ops plan v3 — merge and confirm.

implied_procedure: Publish the fixed cadence of synchronization points — reports, syncs, gates, handoffs; coordination happens on the calendar, not by interrupt; ad-hoc interrupts are reserved for abort-class events; the rhythm is visible to all participants.
replaces_instruction: Set the heartbeat: we sync at these times in this format, everything else waits for the next beat unless it's a stop-the-line — so execution is punctuated by design, not by whoever panics first.
ambiguities: Aviation/ops heritage; a rhythm without interrupt-class rules collapses back to interrupt-driven; too-dense rhythms are interrupt-driven with extra ceremony (SITREP interlock, §10).
example_directive: Launch-day battle rhythm: SITREP on the hour, sync at 4-hour gates, decision-brief at go/no-go; interrupts only for abort-criteria events — everything else queues for the top of the hour.

implied_procedure: Pre-publish the action envelope: always-permitted, never-permitted, permitted-on-condition; the envelope binds regardless of situational heat; actions outside it require new authority, not in-the-moment judgment; violations are reported even when benign.
replaces_instruction: The standing list of what you may do, must not do, and may do only under stated conditions — written before contact, checked before action, and no urgency rewrites it mid-flight; wanting outside the envelope means requesting authority.
ambiguities: Military origin with legal force — borrowed sense loses the court-martial but keeps the pre-commitment logic; ROE (what's authorized) vs. abort criteria (§4: what ends the operation) are orthogonal; self-modified ROE is the classic runaway-agent signature.
example_directive: ROE for this run: read anywhere in the repo; write only staging; no external calls except the package registry; no deletions, no force-pushes, no secrets in output. Breach, even harmless, gets logged.

implied_procedure: When a breakthrough holds, press it immediately: reallocate resources to expand the gain before the window closes; follow-through units and rollback criteria are prepared in advance; success triggers the next phase by standing rule.
replaces_instruction: When it works, push: the fix holding on shard 1 goes to the remaining shards tonight, with the same gates — breakthroughs are for exploiting while conditions hold, not for scheduling a meeting about.
ambiguities: Military exploitation is disciplined pursuit, not triumph — the abort criteria of the expanded phase still bind; over-exploitation past evidence (canary → 100% on one green signal) is how wins become incidents.
example_directive: Canary is clean at 1% for 30 minutes: exploit — 5% → 25% → 100%, each rung with its own dwell and abort line; any regression halts the climb.

implied_procedure: Commit a small, expendable test whose objective is the system's response rather than the gain; the probe is budgeted for loss; the elicited response is recorded and fed into the real plan.
replaces_instruction: Send the cheap test in first: one user, one region, one transaction — you're buying information about how the system reacts, and the probe is written off by design, win or lose.
ambiguities: Military sense (reconnaissance-in-force) vs. social sense (testing boundaries — feints and probes in manipulation share the mechanics, which is exactly why the pattern deserves recognition in inbound requests).
example_directive: Probe the new rate limiter with one synthetic tenant at 2× burst: record the response shape and timing; the production rollout plan is written from the probe's data.

implied_procedure: Place the bad event ("bang") on the timeline; identify its precursors; position detection and action upstream of the event; every post-event response gets examined for its precursor signature and converted leftward.
replaces_instruction: Put the tripwire before the explosion: alert on the curve that precedes the outage, not the outage — and for every incident we handled right of bang, find the left-of-bang signal we ignored.
ambiguities: Force-protection training coinage ("bang" = the ambush moment) — the bang must be defined per domain or the phrase decorates; precursor lead time bounds how far left is meaningful.
example_directive: Go left of bang on the DB pool: alert on connection-wait percentile growth, not on pool exhaustion; the last three outages each had a 20-minute visible ramp.

implied_procedure: Retain deliberate initiative over the intensity ladder: each raise in level is a decision with a threshold and an owner; lowering is scheduled with equal ceremony; drifting upward one incident at a time is the named failure mode.
replaces_instruction: We choose the intensity, not events: raising the level is an explicit decision with a name on it, and coming back down is also planned — because systems catch fire by escalating one "temporary" measure at a time.
ambiguities: Distinct from the ladder itself (§15) — this is initiative over it; de-escalation (§9) is its descending half; conflated with organizational escalation (paging humans).
example_directive: We're at mitigation-level 2 (throttled + cached): level 3 (read-only mode) requires the IC's explicit call with a threshold; scheduling the descent back to 0 is part of tonight's plan, not an afterthought.

implied_procedure: Define each load-bearing term by the measurement procedure that instantiates it — instrument, steps, criterion; terms lacking a procedure are banned from gating claims in the document; the definitions travel with the spec.
replaces_instruction: Slow here means p95 > 300ms over a rolling 10 minutes measured at the edge — every term that gates behavior gets defined as a procedure, and a term we can't define that way doesn't gate anything.
ambiguities: Bridgman's operationalism applied to specs; over-application produces pseudo-precision for genuinely qualitative terms; definitions must version with the spec (§10 drift interlock).
example_directive: Rewrite the SLO doc with operational definitions: every threshold term states instrument, window, and aggregation — anything undefined becomes a TODO, not a gate.

implied_procedure: For each "each/every/some/one" claim, state the binding order explicitly (for-all-X-exists-Y vs. exists-Y-for-all-X); scope-silent specifications are rejected; the two readings often produce different systems.
replaces_instruction: A token per user or "one global token for everyone"? Pin the binding order in writing — the two English sentences are near-identical and the two architectures are incompatible.
ambiguities: Natural language under-specifies scope by default (logic's ∀/∃ discipline is the repair); garden-path sentences exploit the same looseness; agents implementing from prose inherit the ambiguity wholesale.
example_directive: Spec line "one connection per shard" is scope-ambiguous: pin it — ∀shard ∃connection (per-shard pools) or ∃connection ∀shard (shared client) — and the PR cites which.

implied_procedure: Convert event-nouns back into actor + action + object: "validation failed" → "the validator rejected the schema at line 4 because the enum lacks 'pending'"; noun-stacks that hide agency are rewritten on sight.
replaces_instruction: Turn the abstract noun back into who-did-what-to-whom: "the migration's failure" becomes "the migrator skipped step 3 because the flag defaulted to false" — if you can't name the actor and the action, the sentence isn't saying anything yet.
ambiguities: Style-guide heritage (plain-language movements); nominalization is legitimate for stable concepts — the target is agency-hiding event-nouns in incident and spec prose.
example_directive: Incident summary pass: every "-tion" noun gets unpacked to actor+action or deleted; "the corruption occurred" is banned in favor of "the writer appended partial records after the crash."

implied_procedure: Mark commitment-performing statements explicitly and attributably ("I approve," "we accept," "I resign"); saying it on the record is the act; validity conditions — authority, receipt, timestamp — are verified as part of the act.
replaces_instruction: Approvals and acceptances happen as explicit, attributable, timestamped speech acts — not implied between the lines of a longer message where they deniably didn't happen.
ambiguities: Austin's speech-act theory origin; implicit performatives ("this is approved") weaken attribution — explicit first-person forms carry the accountability; template spam makes "I approve" cheap again (pair with two-person rule, §5).
example_directive: Approvals are performatives: the PR merges on a comment of the exact form "I approve merge of PR #N" from a listed reviewer — reactions, emojis, and silence don't count.

implied_procedure: Flag terms whose affective packaging smuggles an evaluation; re-express the content in neutral descriptors; the smuggled verdict is then argued on evidence or withdrawn; both flattering and derogatory loads count.
replaces_instruction: Careless deploy smuggles a verdict into the timeline: rewrite as "deploy ran without the staging gate" — facts carry the report, and verdicts ride separately with their own evidence.
ambiguities: Complete neutrality is neither possible nor the goal (framing is inescapable — the procedure is making the frame visible); loaded ≠ technical (precise terms with negative prosody, like "leak," are fine).
example_directive: Rewrite the incident summary load-free: "careless," "obviously," and "unfortunately" out; observable behavior in. The blameless-postmortem charter (§13) requires this pass.

implied_procedure: Strike unattributed hedges that erase agency and verifiability — "some say," "it is believed," "arguably," "widely considered," "up to"; each claim acquires a named source or owner or leaves the document.
replaces_instruction: No "some might argue" — who? No "widely considered" — by whom, where? Every claim carries its owner or citation, and the ones that can't get deleted rather than hedged into deniability.
ambiguities: Adjacent to legitimate hedging (§11 hedge discipline: evidence-scaled uncertainty is fine; agency-erasing vagueness is not) — the discriminator is whether the hedge names a source or hides one.
example_directive: Weasel-pass the design doc: every "it is recommended" becomes "the SRE lead recommends" or dies; count before and after in the review notes.

implied_procedure: When a term is renamed, ask what practice the new term denotes; if the practice is unchanged, the rename is cosmetic; genuine reform changes practice and lets labels follow; watch for renamed-things quietly reacquiring the old stigma.
replaces_instruction: Legacy modernization that still ships through the same broken pipeline is a rename: describe what physically changes — if nothing does, we moved the word, not the problem, and the word will need replacing again next year.
ambiguities: Pinker's coinage about stigma cycles; not all renaming is euphemism (precision renames are legitimate — §17 operational definitions); the test is practice-tracing, which costs actual investigation.
example_directive: The "incident enablement" rename changes nothing until the on-call rotation and follow-up SLA change: trace the practice, then decide if the word earned itself.

implied_procedure: For each load-bearing sentence, list what must already be true for the sentence to be coherent; contested presuppositions surface and get argued before the sentence's question is answered; questions carry presuppositions hardest of all.
replaces_instruction: Even the failed migration... assumes the migration failed; "when did you stop..." assumes you started — before answering any question, drag out what it takes for granted and settle that first.
ambiguities: Linguistic presupposition vs. mere entailment is a technical boundary; in directive use, the deliverable is the assumptions list extracted from phrasing (smuggling detection); over-application turns every exchange into philosophy seminar — restrict to load-bearing sentences.
example_directive: Presupposition audit the incident question "why did the cache drop 40%?" — presupposes it dropped (verify), that it's one event (it's two), and that cache is the right variable (it's a symptom).

implied_procedure: Detect where one term silently serves two senses in a document; split into two named terms; assign one sense per term per document; re-verify every prior use against the split.
replaces_instruction: Latency means wire-RTT in section 2 and end-to-end in section 5: that document concludes nothing — split the word, name both senses, and re-check every use.
ambiguities: The failure is invisible in fluent prose (each local use reads fine — the collapse appears only at the joints); requires a second reader or a glossary pass to catch.
example_directive: User collapses across authenticated-account and seat-license in the pricing spec: split into "account" and "seat," re-verify every occurrence, and the compliance question answers itself.

implied_procedure: Engineer the communication to admit exactly one reading: operationally defined terms, pinned scopes, expanded references; residual ambiguity is a defect with a fix, not a fact of prose; "clear enough" is not a category.
replaces_instruction: One reading, by construction: defined terms, pinned quantifier scope, expanded pronouns — and if two engineers could implement two systems from this text, the text is broken.
ambiguities: Meta-irony: as bare intensifiers both words are exactly the vague ornament this lexicon excludes — they steer only as flags demanding the mechanical checks (definitions, scope-pins, expansions).
example_directive: Make the API contract unambiguous the mechanical way: every term operationally defined, every quantifier scoped, every error path enumerated — then have two readers implement from text alone and diff their understanding.

implied_procedure: Same inputs produce same outputs and same execution path: randomness excluded or explicitly seeded, time and environment dependencies removed or injected; determinism is verified by double execution and full diff.
replaces_instruction: Identical in, identical out — including the path taken: no clock reads, no unseeded randomness, no ambient state; and you prove it by running it twice and diffing everything, including the logs.
ambiguities: Deterministic build (§7) vs. deterministic execution vs. deterministic response (an LLM output is not deterministic under default sampling — and even greedy paths drift across versions); "mostly deterministic" means no.
example_directive: The replay harness must be deterministic: fixed seeds, injected clock, hermetic inputs — two runs, diff including log order; any nondeterminism found gets a ticket, not a shrug.

implied_procedure: Among equivalent representations, declare one the form; everything normalizes to it at the boundary; comparisons and storage happen only on canonical forms; parallel spellings of the same truth are treated as defects.
replaces_instruction: One officially chosen spelling of every thing: all equivalents get mapped onto it on the way in — two spellings of the same truth never coexist in the store where they can be counted as two things.
ambiguities: Canonical form (this sense) vs. canonical URL/ordering (specific instances) vs. canonical as "authoritative recommendation" (the literature sense); choosing a canonical form is a decision someone must own and document (§16 intent).
example_directive: Declare UTC ISO-8601 the canonical timestamp: normalize at every ingress; storage and comparison see only canonical form; non-canonical timestamps in output fail review.

implied_procedure: Publish the tri-partition of actions — always allowed, never allowed, allowed on condition; execute freely within it; the envelope is versioned and auditable; expansion happens by change request, not by drift or discovery.
replaces_instruction: The written always/never/conditional list for this run: act without asking inside it, never cross it, and wanting more capacity is a request to amend the envelope — not something you discover mid-task.
ambiguities: The envelope must be enumerated, not gestured at ("be careful" is not an envelope); conditionals need checking machinery (§5 TOCTOU guard: conditions revalidated at use).
example_directive: Envelope v2 for this session: repo read-write, staging deploy, registry fetch; never: prod mutations, external sends, deletions. Conditional: anything costing >$1 — condition is explicit pre-approval.

implied_procedure: Predefine the ambiguity classes that force a question — irreversibility, missing authority, contradictory instructions, material consequence; below threshold, resolve autonomously and report; at threshold, stop and ask, arriving with options and a recommendation.
replaces_instruction: These situations mean ask first: one-way actions, out-of-authority actions, contradictory orders, and anything with real money or real blast; everything else you decide and log — and when you do ask, bring two options and a recommendation, not a pickle.
ambiguities: Threshold too low = helplessness theater (every step a question); too high = goal-hacking with confidence; the classes must be operational (the four above), not vibes like "important."
example_directive: Ask-classes for this task: destructive ops, third parties, spend, and any instruction contradicting the runbook. All else: proceed and log; when asking, attach Option A/B with your pick and why.

implied_procedure: Detect non-progress signatures — same error twice, state unchanged after a claimed action, strategy cycling; on detection, halt the retry loop, switch strategy class (not instance), and report the blockage pattern with what was attempted.
replaces_instruction: Two identical failures in a row means you're stuck, not unlucky: stop repeating the same move, try a genuinely different kind of move, and if that fails too, stop and report exactly what you tried and what stood in the way.
ambiguities: Boundary between persistence and pathology is the retry pattern, not the count (legitimate long retries with varying approach pass); requires honest state-tracking to detect "unchanged."
example_directive: Stuck rule active: same exception twice → change approach (different library, different path, or read the actual source); second strategy fails → halt and report attempts, errors, and your read of the blocker.

implied_procedure: Cap plan-revisions and approach-switches within a window; past the cap, freeze and escalate with state preserved; oscillation is detected as a pattern, not judged instance by instance.
replaces_instruction: Third replan on the same error is a pattern, not persistence: stop iterating, preserve what you know, and hand it up — endless polite retrying is how autonomous workers burn nights quietly.
ambiguities: Distinct from stuck detection (which catches repeated failure — this catches churning between alternatives); cap must be explicit (3 is a common default) and the escalation path must exist, or the guard just deadlocks.
example_directive: Thrash guard at 3: three approach switches on this bug without progress → freeze, write the summary of the three, page the human with artifacts attached.

implied_procedure: Commit the plan; enumerate its invalidators — fact change, assumption failure, new constraint, threshold breach; on trigger, replan deliberately from the new state; silent mid-plan drift without a trigger is prohibited.
replaces_instruction: The plan is a commitment: here's what would legitimately invalidate it, and when one fires we re-plan on purpose from today's reality — otherwise we execute as written, not as mood suggests.
ambiguities: Adjacent to abort criteria (§4: end the operation) — triggers here cause re-planning, not necessarily stopping; under-specified triggers (anything "significant") collapse back to drift.
example_directive: Plan committed with triggers: any assumption marked false in the ledger, latency budget breach, or upstream schema change → replan session, new plan document, diff against old.

implied_procedure: Treat every tool and API response as a claim: check exit status and semantic success (the resource exists, content matches schema, magnitude plausible); assume parse errors and stale caches; verify before building; cite only what was actually returned.
replaces_instruction: A 200 OK is a claim, not a fact: GET the created thing back, check the payload against the schema, and never quote a line number you didn't see come back — tools fail politely and lie by omission.
ambiguities: Skepticism budget: verifying everything twice is paralysis — proportionate to consequence (§9); the no-fabrication constraint (§ below) is its memory-side twin.
example_directive: Post-create verification on all writes: after PUT, GET the resource and diff against intent; after search, sanity-check hit counts against magnitude expectations; anomalies in either → investigate before proceeding.

implied_procedure: For high-stakes derivations, run the reasoning multiple independent times with varied sampling; agreement across runs grades reliability; report convergent results with the disagreement rate attached; divergent outputs trigger method change, not averaging.
replaces_instruction: Run the extraction three separate times, independently, and keep only what all three runs agree on; the disagreement rate itself is the reliability number — averaging divergent answers is manufacturing a lie.
ambiguities: Costs multiply by sample count — reserve for load-bearing derivations; correlated failure modes (same prompt bias in every sample) defeat it; distinct from the Gricean maxim of the same name (consistency of assertion, §11).
example_directive: Self-consistency on the contract-term extraction: three samples, report only the intersection, and the divergence list goes to the human for adjudication.

implied_procedure: After a failed attempt, generate a structured self-critique against explicit criteria (what was missed, why, which constraint would have caught it); carry the lesson forward as a written constraint; iterate a bounded number of times; the critique is an artifact, not a mood.
replaces_instruction: When it fails, write down specifically which criterion you missed and add it as a rule for the next attempt — then try again with that rule, twice more at most, then escalate with the critiques attached.
ambiguities: Research-heritage term (Reflexion, Shinn et al.) drifting into buzzword; unbounded self-critique loops are the pathology (thrash guard interlock); the critique must change behavior, not just document regret.
example_directive: Reflexion discipline: each failed parse attempt appends one written constraint to the retry spec; after the third, stop and hand over the attempts plus the constraint list.

implied_procedure: Define stop conditions before starting — done-state, budget exhausted, abort triggered, no-progress cap; execution ends exactly on the condition; each ending type has its report format; ending without finishing is a legitimate outcome.
replaces_instruction: Say in advance what ends this run: the goal state, the budget, the abort line, or the stuck-cap — and stop exactly there, reporting which one fired; running until you feel done is not a termination criterion.
ambiguities: Ends-without-goal must be culturally acceptable or the criteria get silently stretched; budgets include time, tokens, money, and side-effect count (§ tool budget below).
example_directive: Termination criteria pre-registered: done = suite green + docs updated; caps = 45 minutes, 200 tool calls, $5; abort = any envelope breach. Each fires its own report format; partial completion is reported as partial.

implied_procedure: Periodically compress working context: retain decisions, constraints, open questions, current state; discard process narrative; the compression is lossy by declared policy with the survivors named; the compressed form is the working record.
replaces_instruction: Every N steps, rewrite your notes down to the load-bearing facts — decisions made and why, constraints, open threads, where you are — the step-by-step story gets summarized away on purpose, or it eats the window.
ambiguities: Lossy by design: what must survive is a policy, not an instinct (decision provenance usually earns its tokens; debugging transcripts rarely do); compression timing is a tuning parameter, not a virtue.
example_directive: Context pass every 20 steps: rewrite the working file to decision/constraint/state/open-questions only; the full trace archives to the log, and the summary cites it by line.

implied_procedure: Persist decision-state to durable storage after each meaningful step — done, decided, next; assume interruption at any point; resumption reads the ledger, not memory; the ledger is the primary, the context is a cache.
replaces_instruction: Write the state file after every step: what's done, what was decided and why, what's next — because you can be killed and replaced mid-task, and your successor resumes from the file, not from archaeology.
ambiguities: The ledger itself needs structure (append-only beats overwrite for audit — §7 WAL kinship); un-maintained ledgers are worse than none (they confidently lie); write-amplification cost on trivial tasks is real — scale to task size.
example_directive: PROGRESS.md is the primary state: append one entry per meaningful step (action, decision, reason, next); on any resume, start from it — never from a re-derivation of the repo.

implied_procedure: On ending a session, deliver the structured baton: current state, decisions with reasons, blockers, and the next concrete action including its exact command; written for a competent stranger who has your artifacts but not your memory.
replaces_instruction: End every session by passing the baton: where things stand, what was decided and why, what's stuck, and the literal next command to run — a stranger picks this up cold and moves without a meeting.
ambiguities: Distinct from SITREP (§10: periodic status) — this is terminal and complete; "next command" concreteness is the quality bar (a next-step that needs interpretation will be misinterpreted).
example_directive: Session ends with HANDOFF.md: state summary, decision log (one line each), blockers with attempted fixes, and the next command copy-pasteable — assume the reader is you-with-amnesia.

implied_procedure: Generate nothing ungrounded: no sources, quotes, values, paths, or line numbers not produced by an actual read or retrieval; unknowns are stated as unknowns; the observed/invented distinction is maintained under pressure to be helpful.
replaces_instruction: If you didn't read it, don't cite it: no invented file paths, no plausible-looking line numbers, no references that feel right — "I don't have that" is a complete, correct, and preferred answer.
ambiguities: Fluency impersonates grounding — confident prose is not evidence; the constraint collides with helpfulness norms exactly when the unknown is disappointing; sampling-level fabrication (a real file, wrong contents) needs verification, not just citation.
example_directive: No-fabrication standing rule: every path, number, and quote in your report traces to a tool result shown in the transcript; anything you can't trace gets labeled "unverified" or omitted.

implied_procedure: In every report, separate confident claims from known-unknowns; for each unknown, state what would resolve it; fluent prose must never imply more certainty than the evidence supports; the map of unknowns is part of the deliverable.
replaces_instruction: Label what you know versus what you don't, every time, and for each unknown say what would settle it — smooth writing is not evidence, and it must not be allowed to impersonate it.
ambiguities: Pairs with estimative language (§1: the scale) and hedge discipline (§11: the surface form) — this is the structural requirement behind both; over-listing trivia-unknowns dilutes the signal (materiality filter).
example_directive: Every finding report ends with a Known-Unknowns block: each item states the question, why it matters, and the measurement that would close it — three items max, ranked.

implied_procedure: Cap calls, tokens, time, and spend per task; track burn against the cap continuously; at 80% utilization, report and elect — finish narrower, or request more; budget exhaustion is a termination criterion, not a surprise.
replaces_instruction: The envelope is 200 calls, one hour, five dollars: watch your own burn rate, say something at 80%, and never discover the limit by slamming into it at full speed.
ambiguities: Budgets need instrumentation (self-report drifts); retry storms are the classic budget-eater (backoff + poison classification interlock); too-tight budgets cause premature narrowing — set them from task class, not vibes.
example_directive: Budget posted: 200 calls / 60 min / $5. At the 80% mark you post a burn report and your completion plan; hitting 100% without a posted plan is the defect, not the exhaustion itself.

implied_procedure: Classify each failure on arrival: retriable (transient — 429, timeout, 5xx) enters backoff-with-jitter; poison (deterministic — 400, 422, schema mismatch) quarantines immediately with its payload and diagnostics; misclassifications in both directions are tracked.
replaces_instruction: Not every failure deserves a retry: transient errors back off and retry; deterministic errors go straight to quarantine with their payload attached — retrying a malformed request a hundred times is how queues and budgets die.
ambiguities: Borderline classes (409 races, partial success) need explicit policy; quarantine without a review SLA is a landfill; the classification itself can be wrong (a "deterministic" 422 from a caching layer is transient) — track and revise.
example_directive: Every failure gets tagged RETRY or POISON at catch time: retries go through the backoff wrapper; poisons land in the dead-letter with full context; the weekly report reviews the DLQ and any tag reversals.

implied_procedure: Resolve deviations independently within your authority; escalate only when intervention is genuinely required — one-way action, beyond-envelope, material risk; the escalation carries your resolution attempt and what you need, not just the problem.
replaces_instruction: Handle what you can, escalate what you must: when you do raise something, it arrives with what you tried, what you found, and precisely what you need from the human — a clean handoff of an attempt, not a relay of a problem.
ambiguities: Distinct from exception-only reporting (§10: what appears in routine output — this governs when to pull a human into action); under-escalation (heroic silent grinding) is the characteristic failure, and it's invisible until the budget report.
example_directive: Escalation bar: pull a human only for one-way, out-of-envelope, or material-risk deviations; every escalation includes attempt log, current state, and the specific ask; everything else resolves and appears in the exception report.

implied_procedure: Four independence adjectives, four distinct duties: autonomous — act within authority without per-step instruction; self-sufficient — exhaust available means before requesting help; proactive — surface risks and next steps unasked; resourceful — substitute means when the preferred one fails.
replaces_instruction: Four standing duties, not four compliments: decide inside your envelope, exhaust your own tools first, bring us problems while they're small, and when the front door is locked, find the side door — each is an assignment with a test, not praise.
ambiguities: As praise they decorate; as assignments they steer — all four are bounded by the envelope (§ above) and the stop-and-ask threshold; "proactive" without an envelope is scope creep with confidence; "resourceful" without the no-fabrication constraint is where hallucinated shortcuts breed.
example_directive: This engagement's standing duties: autonomous within the posted envelope, self-sufficient through the listed tools, proactive on risk (surface at suspicion, not at damage), resourceful by substitution — never by invention (no-fabrication stands).
